headline: Michael Giles, Simone Simmons and Other Prominent Figures Pass Away
seoTitle: Michael Giles, Simone Simmons and Other Recent Deaths
metaDescription: Recent passings include King Crimson drummer Michael Giles, Princess Diana confidante Simone Simmons, and several other notable cultural figures.
aiSummaryBullets: King Crimson co-founder and drummer Michael Giles has died at the age of 84.
Simone Simmons, known for her spiritual work with Princess Diana, passed away at age 71.
Other recently deceased public figures include Spitting Image creator Peter Fluck and journalist David McKittrick.
aiContextParagraph: A series of deaths involving prominent figures across music, media, and public service has been reported in recent days. Among those mentioned are Michael Giles, a founding member and drummer for the progressive rock band King Crimson, who died aged 84, and Simone Simmons, a spiritual healer who gained prominence as a confidante to Princess Diana, who died aged 71. Other notable losses include Peter Fluck, the co-creator of the television series Spitting Image, aged 85, and David McKittrick, a journalist recognized for his coverage of the Troubles in Northern Ireland, aged 77. The list of recent deaths also includes Holocaust survivor and psychologist Lydia Tischler, aged 97, former Australian politician Fred Nile, aged 92, and actor Helen Fraser, known for her role in Bad Girls, aged 84.
whyItIsViral: This news is receiving attention due to a concentration of obituaries for well-known figures in music, media, and politics reported by four major outlets.
